description: CMON - Base GNSS de la Cité administrative de Montluçon (03) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Montluçon Communauté. GNSS base of Montluçon Community services (CMON) located in the commune of Montluçon (03). Characteristics: - Antenna: ArduSimple AS-ANT3B-CAL - Receiver: ArduSimple simpleRTK3B Pro - Observed constellations: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, Beidou and SBAS - Frequency bands: L1 + L2/E5b + L5/E5a. Coverage: Montluçon Communauté. The portal shows the English title as "CMON - GNSS Base of the Cité administratif de Montluçon (03)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Montluçon Communauté. Its keywords include montlucon, gnss, rtk, systemes-de-maillage-geographique, auvergne-rhone-alpes, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 6 download or service links in OGC:WMS, 0-HTTP--LINK. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
